x: The G2 Mains 2025 key (Carpediem) matches Bulusu Sambamurty with Vadarevu, Dandu Narayana Raju with Mattapalem and Kasi Viswanadham with Kakinada, so Vadarevu = Bulusu Sambamurthy.
source: Carpediem AP History G2 PYQs 2000-2025 (src/ap-history/cdi-ap-history-g2-pyqs-2000-2025.txt) p.38-39
evidence: NextGen AP History Part 19 (src/ap-history/ap-history-appsc-19.txt) p.4 (Bulusu at Chollangi)
dispute: Old app notes: Kasi Viswanadham led at Vadarevu and Bulusu at Kakinada/Chollangi (NextGen p.4 also has Bulusu at Chollangi). The G2 Mains 2025 key in Carpediem gives Bulusu – Vadarevu, Kasi Viswanadham – Kakinada.
